capabilityHints.summary: A creator launches a WETH-paired token in one canonical v4 pool whose LP fee reprices itself every swap from realized volatility, so passive LPs are paid the most exactly when toxic flow is worst and traders pay the least in calm markets, with no external price source, admin, keeper or upgrade.

components.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical dynamic-fee PoolKey. It binds exactly one pool once at afterInitialize, returns a per-swap LP-fee override computed from the pool's own EWMA realized volatility, and accrues the mandatory Programmable volume fee on the executed gross quote-side amount across all four swap quadrants.

Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool, seeds one full-range position and settles both currencies; any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.
Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists.

project.summary: One v4 hook on a canonical dynamic-fee pool: the LP fee auto-calibrates to the pool's OWN realized volatility (an EWMA of the per-swap tick delta, no external price source or keeper) so LPs are paid more in volatile markets and traders less in calm ones; the hook also enforces the mandatory Programmable volume fee (10 bps platform owner liability plus the project remainder as a project-claimable liability) non-bypassably on the same pool.
project.title: VolFee
